summary.text: Blake Doriot is a Republican member of the Indiana Senate for District 12, serving since 2016.
The caucus page lists Doriot as Assistant Majority Whip and ranking member of the Pensions and Labor Committee.

paragraphs.text: Doriot holds a B.S. in construction from Purdue University and owns B Doriot & Associates Land Surveying.
The page lists Doriot as a former court-appointed special advocate in Elkhart County and a past Grand Knight for the Knights of Columbus.
Doriot represents portions of Elkhart County, and the page also lists service on the Indiana Commission on Hispanic/Latino Affairs Board.
